g01.note: borrow는 내가 빌려 오는 것, lend는 남에게 빌려주는 거예요.

g02.note: bring은 말하는 사람 쪽으로 가져오기, take는 다른 곳으로 가져가기예요.

g03.note: hear는 저절로 들리는 것, listen은 귀 기울여 듣는 것(listen to)이에요.

g04.note: look은 눈길을 주는 것(look at), watch는 움직이는 것을 지켜보는 거예요(TV, 경기).

g05.note: say는 말 자체(say hello), tell은 누구에게 알려 주기(tell me), talk는 대화하기예요.

g06.note: fun은 즐거운, funny는 웃기는. The game was fun / The clown was funny.

g07.note: -ed는 사람이 느끼는 감정(I'm bored), -ing는 그 감정을 일으키는 것(It's boring)이에요.

g08.note: alone은 혼자 있는 상태, lonely는 외로운 감정이에요. 혼자여도 외롭지 않을 수 있어요.

g09.note: hope는 이루어질 수 있는 일, wish는 이루기 어려운 일을 바랄 때 써요.

g10.note: travel은 주로 동사(여행하다), trip은 명사(한 번의 짧은 여행)예요.

g11.note: win은 이기다, lose는 지다. 둘 다 '경기를'은 목적어로 바로 써요(win the game).

g12.note: quiet(콰이어트)는 조용한, quite(콰이트)는 꽤. 끝 철자 순서가 달라요.

g13.note: during 뒤에는 명사(during the class), while 뒤에는 주어+동사(while I was sleeping).

g14.note: already 이미(긍정문), yet 아직(부정문·의문문), still 여전히(계속되는 중).

g15.note: advice는 명사(어드바이스, c), advise는 동사(어드바이즈, s)예요.

g16.note: between은 둘 사이, among은 셋 이상 사이예요.

g17.note: raise는 무언가를 올리다(raise your hand), rise는 스스로 오르다(the sun rises).

g19.note: dis-가 붙으면 반대 뜻이 돼요. 나타나다 ↔ 사라지다.

g20.note: affect는 동사(영향을 주다), effect는 명사(영향, 효과)예요.

g21.note: in-은 늘다, de-는 줄다. 둘 다 동사와 명사로 써요.

g22.note: mental은 정신의, physical은 신체의. mental health / physical health

g23.note: positive는 긍정적인, negative는 부정적인. 서로 반대말이에요.

g24.note: dis-가 붙으면 반대 뜻. 장점 ↔ 단점

g26.note: trash와 garbage는 둘 다 쓰레기(셸 수 없는 명사), waste는 쓰레기도 되고 낭비도 돼요.

g27.note: 둘 다 중고의. a used car = a secondhand car.

questions.en: What do you usually do on weekends?
questions.ex: I usually play soccer with my friends on weekends. Sometimes I watch movies with my family.

questions.en: What is your favorite subject? Why?
questions.ex: My favorite subject is science because I like doing experiments. It is fun and interesting.

questions.en: Tell me about your best friend.
questions.ko: 가장 친한 친구에 대해 말해 주세요.
questions.st: My best friend is ... He/She is ...
questions.ex: My best friend is Jiho. He is funny and kind. We often play games together after school.

questions.en: What do you want to be in the future?
questions.st: I want to be a ... because ...
questions.ex: I want to be a game designer because I love games. I want to create fun games for people.

questions.en: What did you do last weekend?
questions.ex: Last weekend, I visited my grandparents. We ate delicious food and took a walk in the park.

questions.en: How do you go to school?
questions.st: I go to school by ... / I walk to school.
questions.ex: I walk to school. It takes about fifteen minutes. I usually go with my friend.
My hobby is drawing pictures. I draw my favorite characters in my free time.

questions.en: Where do you want to travel? Why?
questions.st: I want to travel to ... because ...
questions.ex: I want to travel to Canada because I want to see beautiful nature. I also want to practice English there.

questions.ex: To stay healthy, I exercise three times a week. I also try to eat vegetables and sleep early.

questions.st: There are ... people in my family.
questions.ex: There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger brother, and me. We often have dinner together.

questions.en: What club are you in? What do you do there?
questions.st: I am in the ... club. We ...
questions.ex: I am in the music club. We practice songs together and perform at the school festival.

questions.en: What can we do to protect the environment?
questions.ko: 환경을 지키려면 무엇을 할 수 있을까요?
questions.ex: We can recycle bottles and cans. We should also use less plastic and save water.

questions.en: What do you do when you feel stressed?
questions.ex: When I feel stressed, I listen to music. Sometimes I talk with my friends, and then I feel better.

questions.en: What is your plan for this vacation?
questions.st: I am going to ... / I will ...
questions.ex: I am going to read ten books this vacation. I will also learn how to swim.

questions.en: What is your favorite season? Why?
questions.ex: My favorite season is winter because I like snow. I can go skiing with my family.

questions.en: Have you ever been to another country?
questions.ko: 다른 나라에 가 본 적 있어요?
questions.st: Yes, I have been to ... / No, I haven't.
questions.ex: Yes, I have been to Japan. I visited Osaka with my family last year. The food was amazing.

questions.en: Who do you respect the most? Why?
questions.ex: I respect my mom the most because she works hard and always supports me.

questions.en: What is a good habit you have?
questions.st: I have a good habit. I ...
questions.ex: I have a good habit. I make my bed every morning. It makes me feel ready for the day.
